definitions.explanation: an error in calculation or an incorrect assessment of a situation

examples.japanese: それは{大|おお}きな{誤算|ごさん}だった。
{時間|じかん}の{誤算|ごさん}で{遅刻|ちこく}してしまった。
examples.english: I was late due to a miscalculation of time.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}の{実力|じつりょく}を{見誤|みあやま}ったのが{誤算|ごさん}だった。
examples.english: Misjudging the opponent's ability was my miscalculation.

notes:
NUANCE:
{誤算|ごさん} goes beyond numerical errors to include strategic misjudgments and mistaken predictions about outcomes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誤算|ごさん}があった - there was a miscalculation
- {大|おお}きな{誤算|ごさん} - major miscalculation
- {誤算|ごさん}に{終|お}わる - to end in a miscalculation

RELATED TERMS:
- {計算|けいさん}{違|ちが}い - calculation error
- {見込|みこ}み{違|ちが}い - mistaken expectation
- {判断|はんだん}ミス - judgment error
